product.olivetti-m4-90.summary: The 90 MHz M4 Modulo on this platform in the Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-m4-90.history: Olivetti placed the M4 Modulo in its professional range. This Pentium generation shared a platform with several consumer PCS models. Supplier I-O Data listed the CD version in its Japanese compatibility table. The guide identifies TriGem as the maker of the BA2199 board.
product.olivetti-m4-90.architecture: The case sets the expansion capacity. The Tin Box riser offers 3 full-length ISA, one PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-m4-90.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-90.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-90.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 12
product.olivetti-m4-90.io-data: I-O Data, Getronics Olivetti desktop memory compatibility table
product.olivetti-m4-90.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.13.
